blurb: Heather Hills Golf Club is built on 165 acres of undulating, wooded land in the northwest corner of Macomb County. Nestled among natural beauty roads, it is immediately apparent why it has been called a hidden gem. The original 9 holes opened in the summer of 1979; the second 9 followed in the fall of 1991. The course offers Bluegrass tees and fairways and Bentgrass greens.
